description: Queries the public calibration and backtest ledger of Tresslers Group sovereign intelligence models. Supports filtering by settlement type ('contract_settled' for live prediction markets, 'outcome_tracked' for internal foresight models, 'unscored_archive' for pre-commitment history, or 'all'). Returns Brier calibration scores, transparent failure analysis, and verifiable primary source URLs.

settlement_type.description: Filter by settlement tier: 'contract_settled' (live prediction market order-books), 'outcome_tracked' (internal Bayesian foresight), 'unscored_archive' (pre-commitment era), or 'all' (default).
